dataset_name: VarshaMitra Maharashtra Monsoon Multi-Source Meteorological Dataset

training_split.role: Model parameter estimation and regime classification fitting

validation_split.role: Out-of-fold temporal cross-fitting and split-conformal calibration isolation

locked_test_split.role: Locked scientific holdout for B0-B4 evaluation and uncertainty coverage audit

raw_nwp_forecast.operational_role: Primary numerical weather prediction input (proxy for NCMRWF NCUM / BharatFS)
raw_nwp_forecast.access_protocol: AWS Open Data / NOAA NOMADS Open Access

observed_rainfall.note: Calibrated against historical IMD Pune monsoon rainfall distributions with extreme orographic weighting

atmospheric_dynamics.operational_role: Synoptic circulation diagnostics (u850, v850, u200, v200, MSLP, RH850, vorticity, MFC)
atmospheric_dynamics.note: Derived according to standard WMO synoptic shear and moisture divergence definitions

topography_dem.operational_role: High-resolution elevation, zonal slope, meridional slope, and upslope mechanical flow calculation

district_boundaries.source_provider: Survey of India / DataMeet India Maps (Census 2011)
district_boundaries.operational_role: 36-district Maharashtra polygon shapefiles for zonal aggregation and GIS visualization

feature_leakage_audit.target_leakage: VERIFIED_ZERO (No precip_obs or post-forecast metrics in input feature vectors)
feature_leakage_audit.temporal_leakage: VERIFIED_ZERO (Strict chronological ordering; locked test set strictly isolated)

scientific_limitations: Single-season regional evaluation: Validated exclusively on 2024 monsoon over Maharashtra.
Break Monsoon sample sparsity: Break Monsoon occurs in only 34 grid cells in locked September test set.
Western Disturbance transfer function: Non-parametric EQM used in place of tree ensemble.
Forecast vs Observation: Explanations describe model behavior, not physical causality.
